title: Layer 3 round 1 nit collector UX+security: the degraded report line's triple restatement; the broken forms' absolute state path

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in ff331dd9: the degraded report line reads next-step-first with the kind token trailing as the machine-form cross-reference — one statement of the condition; the broken forms fold the home prefix to ~ in the rendered state path (the refs sanitizer's degenerate-HOME rule shared), keeping the diagnostic actionable without the account segment.
